context: Hiroshi-boss introduces the company to a new hire.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: company orientation; corporate vocabulary (株式会社/会長/職員/法人/事務所) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ようこそ、我が株式会社へ。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm composed welcoming clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 株式会社の歴史は、長いんですか?
lines.en: Does the company have a long history?
lines.style: curious young hire voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会長が、五十年前に立ち上げたんだ。
lines.en: The chairman founded it fifty years ago.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 職員は、何名いるんですか?
lines.style: attentive young hire voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今、職員は二百名ほどだ。
lines.en: Now there are about two hundred staff.
lines.style: clear boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 法人としての強みは、何ですか?
lines.en: What's the strength as a corporation?
lines.style: thoughtful young hire voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 法人としての信用が、我々の財産だ。
lines.en: Our credibility as a corporation is our asset.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この事務所で、頑張ります!
lines.en: I'll do my best at this office!
lines.style: eager young hire voice, soft warm determined closing throughout
